description: Batch06: 80 original A2-C1 bilingual first-pass drafts; every independent source, Myanmar, example, CEFR and pronunciation task is pending. C1 is provisional and likely needs extensive reclassification.

audio_review.task: Only after text approval: produce George/Emma recordings and listen to each on real devices including iPhone Safari.
